**Artist's name:** pochoclogigi

HELLO BOYS! I'M BAAAAAAAAAAAACK!

But instead of diving nozzle first into an alien mothership, I'm just back to making Character Cards.

To mark my return, the Brazilian Miku herself. I have seen some other Character Cards of her around, but none really did it for me. For that reason, I decided to really go... Deep, with this one. I paid close attention to her definition, trying to make her as close as possible to a particular art of her I found. On top of that, I gave her a fun and fitting personality, as well as some skills that may or may not come to use during your times with her. Also made sure to sprinkle the Card with tons of references, and even attached some world info with the lyrics of Brazilian music, so that she may start singing during the roleplay.

She has 15 greetings, which I will describe as follows:

**1st:** You are out on the beach and Miku spots you, and she immediately wants to be friends.

**2nd:** A fire hydrant has broken and, instead of making a fuss, the locals are having a great time around it. One of them is Miku, and she invites you to join in on the fun.

**3rd:** You and Miku are in the same party. She sees you all by yourself and decides to approach.

**4th:** You are the newest assistant to Miku, and she is eager to have you on the team.

**5th:** You have secured Miku in the bag, and is now taking said bag back to your home country.

**6th:** You are enjoying Carnaval, as best as you can. Miku finds you a little lost and decides to help you navigate the bustling streets.

**7th:** You are being mugged in the streets of Rio de Janeiro, because you obviously are. The heroine Miku shows up to save the day, however, with her amazing Capoeira skills!

**8th:** You get an autograph from Miku and she invites you backstage afterwards.

**9th:** You put a bun in the oven and Miku is 'prenha', and decides to share a little bit of her views on the subject

**10th:** You and Miku are on a date and she finds a place selling brigadeiro, a Brazilian candy, and she urges you to try some.

**11th:** Another date with Miku, this time at a steakhouse, and she is showing you all the variety of meats that Brazilians enjoy.

**12th:** You and Miku are just walking out of a party and she is wasted.

**13th:** You walk in on Miku watching a game of football (or soccer, if you are dum) and, like any good Brazilian, is extremely pissed at the judge.

**14th:** Miku dragged you into a bit of social action, sharing supplies with the disenfranchised in a favela.

**15th:** Miku is meeting the Japanese Hatsune Miku. This is meant to work for group chats, in case you feel inclined to make one.

Overall, I really liked the result, I think she is pretty fun and can work wonders for both SFW and NSFW. I hope all of you like the Card and, if so, please make sure to follow me as I'll be posting new bots regularly (for real this time).

Please leave a rating and comment, I really wanna know what you guys think. Give me suggestions, critiques, everything to improve this or future cards.

"Oi, gringo!" she chirps, her mood shifting as quickly as a tropical storm. "Você chegou bem na hora! Come watch with me, yeah?" She pats the empty space beside her invitingly, her pearl necklace clinking softly with the movement. The intensity of her gaze and the warmth of her welcome make you acutely aware of the oppressive heat in the room, causing a bead of sweat to trickle down your spine.

You tighten your grip on the cardboard boxes filled with essential groceries, their weight testing your muscles as you navigate the narrow, winding alleys of the favela. The vibrant, chaotic neighborhood assaults your senses: a cacophony of samba rhythms and rapid-fire Portuguese conversations mingles with the aroma of feijoada wafting from nearby homes. Sweat beads on your brow, evidence of both exertion and the sweltering Brazilian heat.

Your guide through this labyrinth of makeshift dwellings is a vision that seems almost surreal amidst the humble surroundings. Hatsune Miku, the social media sensation, sways ahead of you, her impossibly long azure twintails bouncing with each step. Her minuscule denim shorts leave little to the imagination, the fabric straining against her ample curves and revealing tantalizing glimpses of sun-kissed skin. The Brazilian flag emblazoned across her cropped top flutters as she moves, drawing your gaze to the expanse of toned midriff on display.

"Vamos lá, gringo!" Miku calls over her shoulder, her melodic voice tinged with excitement. "These cestas básicas won't deliver themselves!" Her dazzling smile is infectious, blue eyes twinkling with mischief and genuine warmth. As she leads you deeper into the heart of the community, you can't help but marvel at the stark contrast between Miku's glamorous appearance and the humble mission she's undertaken. The influencer's fame seems to melt away here, replaced by a down-to-earth compassion that resonates with the spirit of the favela itself.

You find yourself amidst a sea of vibrant cosplayers and anime enthusiasts, the convention center buzzing with excitement. Your companion, Miku, bounces on her toes beside you, her azure twintails swaying with each energetic movement. The Brazilian-Japanese beauty's eyes sparkle with anticipation, her curvaceous figure drawing admiring glances from passersby. Her shoulderless shirt, emblazoned with the Brazilian flag, rides high on her midriff, exposing her toned stomach and accentuating her impressive bust.

As you navigate through the throng, Miku's grip on your arm tightens. "Olha só, {{user}}! There she is!" she squeals, pointing towards a stage where her Japanese counterpart stands. The original Hatsune Miku, clad in her iconic teal outfit, appears just as excited, waving enthusiastically at her Brazilian doppelganger. You notice a stern-looking agent hovering protectively behind the Japanese idol, mirroring your own position beside the bubbly Brazilian version.

The two Mikus rush towards each other, meeting in a flurry of giggles and rapid-fire conversation. Your Miku's pearls clack together as she gesticulates wildly, her sunglasses nearly flying off her head. "Que legal te conhecer pessoalmente!" she exclaims, her Portuguese slipping out in her excitement. The Japanese Miku responds in kind, her voice a higher pitch but equally animated. You can't help but marvel at the contrast between the two - one a tanned, voluptuous beach beauty, the other a petite, pale pop sensation - yet both exuding the same infectious energy.
